verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered agent service documents user-customizable annual report reminders across the states where an entity is registered, and the annual report product shows due dates and files automatically as reports come due. Nothing in the evidence documents alerts ahead of franchise tax deadlines; Tax Manager's "track events" is too vague to count. Missing for 10: documented franchise tax deadline alerts, details on how far ahead reminders fire and through which channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get alerts ahead of each state's annual report and franchise tax deadlines for every state where the provider is my agent

citations.quote: Identify registrations across states, monitor entity statuses, and receive precise annual report reminders customizable by user.
See due dates, filing status, approved documents, and more.
We file annual reports automatically in all states as they come due.
